ops.title: worker/daemon tests flake under parallel package load
ops.description: Reproduced 2026-07-25 on clean v0.20.2 (worktree at fe1418f, no local changes): parallel four-package run fails 5-7 worker-package tests (TestRunTimeout*, TestRunCaptures*, TestRunDrains*, TestTotalTimeout*, TestClose*, TestRuntimeClaim*, TestClaimRuntimeVerifierLane*) with context-deadline exceeded at fast wall times (0.3-1s), while go test -p 1 (serial) passes everything. Same class flaked in CI and locally during the 2026-07-25 v0.20.x release work, twice attributed to 'timing under load' without a record. Hypotheses to check: fixed short deadlines (2s TotalTimeout budgets) missing under CPU contention, or cross-package sharing of real user-level state (e.g. lock files under ~/.daemonkit) instead of t.TempDir isolation — fast failures at 0.3s suggest contention on a shared resource, not slow timeouts.

ops.text: go test ./proc/ ./worker/ ./daemon/ ./service/ -count=1 (parallel, default -p) passes 5 consecutive runs on a loaded machine
